items.name: Koalafication Brisbane 2019
items.information:
This competition is part of a series of events around Australia to enable competitors to obtain qualifying results for the upcoming WCA World Championship 2019 in Melbourne. For more information, visit the [WCA World Championship 2019 website](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/). 

Please note that you only have to attend the day(s) with the events you are competing in, so please check the schedule. Due to parking restrictions we suggest you only attend on Sunday morning if you are competing in 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.

**Contact Us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

items.name: No Place For DNF Spring 2019
items.information:
The main event of this competition is 3x3 Fewest Moves.

-We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. If you miss your group, you will be disqualified from that event.

-Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants.

-Food and drinks are **NOT** permitted inside the main room.  You may eat in the cafeteria next door.There are a few restaurants within a ten minute drive. 

-Live results will be posted on cubecomps.com.

-All proceeds from the competition will be donated to the No Place for Hate® club of Emmaus High School. Proceeds will not be donated to ADL directly.

-CubeDepot will sponsor the competition and will be a vendor!

**A local newspaper photographer will be taking pictures of the competition. If you would not like to have your picture taken, please let us know.**

**Please observe silence during FMC and blindfold events.**

**This competition will not be holding the famous 3x3 speedsolve event. We still encourage newer competitors to try out other events!**

items.name: Cubearte Caracas 2019

venue.name: Escuela Tecnica de Artes Visuales Cristobal Rojas
venue.address: Escuela Tecnica de Artes Visuales Cristobal Rojas

items.information:
El torneo se realizará en el Salón Principal de la Escuela Técnica de Artes Visuales Cristóbal Rojas, en Caracas, Distrito Capital.

**[URGENTE] Nos entristece profundamente saber que Venezuela ha sufrido un gran corte de energía desde el jueves por la noche, hora local. Las escuelas están cerradas por el día y se ha ordenado a los trabajadores que se queden en casa.**

**Como hay un concurso programado para este fin de semana en Caracas, nos gustaría anunciar que existe la posibilidad de que [Cubearte Caracas 2019] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubearteCaracas2019) sea cancelado. Los competidores que se hayan inscrito recibirán un correo electrónico sobre este asunto en breve.**

**Nos gustaría extender nuestras condolencias a Enrymar Cisneros (Candidato Delegado de WCA - Venezuela) y amigos en Venezuela. Se publicará una actualización sobre este asunto tan pronto como sea posible.**

***WCA Competition Announcement Team***
______

The competition will be held at Escuela Tecnica de Artes Visuales Cristobal Rojas Main Hall, on Caracas, Capital District.

**[URGENT] We are deeply saddened to learn that Venezuela has been under a major power outage since Thursday evening local time. Schools are closed for the day and workers have been ordered to stay at home.**

**As there is a competition scheduled to be held in Caracas this weekend, we would like to announce that there is a possibility [Cubearte Caracas 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubearteCaracas2019) will be cancelled. Competitors that have registered will be emailed about this matter shortly.**

**We would like to extend our condolences to Enrymar Cisneros(WCA Candidate Delegate - Venezuela) and friends in Venezuela. An update regarding this matter will be posted as soon as possible.**

***WCA Competition Announcement Team***
